The Actor, the Fool, and the comic artist took their curtain calls one by one, until only a hazy, familiar figure remained on stage: "Old friend, Here I come~" Come, return to the moment of dusk with me! Hear the Leviathans howl across the cosmos, watch the nouspores flee through the shadows. Humans as puny as specks of dust lived precarious lives, and yet it was the age when heroes rode as recklessly as wild horses. Akivili's Express flashed across the cosmos like a meteor, and we sped past, laughing and treading on the fanged maw of the beast... Go seek adversaries worthy of mettle, games that while away the hours, and outcomes indifferent to victory or defeat. Go chase laughter that leaves the audience breathless, twists born of fate's whimsy, and songs that ascend our soul. It's not me seeking the Elation: it's the Elation following in my footsteps! The gods were still young in those days: not yet numb, not yet silent as they are now. We blazed towards the end of the cosmos, and there, Akivili vanished at the border of the universe, fading into an insignificant spot of light, and I, too, became a headless God. The cosmos fell quiet once again, but the spark we left behind still waits for the day it ignites a raging wildfire. Now, we take the stage together, just as it began a thousand Amber Eras ago. "Every side of me, every step I have ever taken: these are all me. And yet, none of them is the whole of me." The Actor, the Fool, and the comic artist embrace each other, sighing, weeping, marveling, laughing... They walk toward the first "Aha," and become the last "Aha." "For this unprecedented Phantasmoon Games, I shall offer you an unprecedented miracle!" The full moon rises, and the Supplicants will draw back the curtains and step onto the stage, smiling. "Old friend, have you found your answer? Shh, it's alright if you haven't. It was never the proof that mattered." Self-introduction complete. And so, I, Aha, issue this invitation to everyone across the entire cosmos: "Let us revel in unabated joy, and take the stage for this... final Improv Tour!"

1512.description:
Soaring clearest skies and bluest oceans, wings sweep up the sea spray, transforming it into a new melody.
Following the lingering echoes of memory, she embraces the unexpected along the way, seeking inspiration for a melodic variation—
Beyond the melody, how else can the Harmony sing?
stories: She hears the sound of a beautiful dream shattering. Ten system hours ago, the Charmony Festival was forced to be canceled. Three system hours ago, the confessional of Bronze Melodia was swamped by lost and confused masses. One system hour ago, The Family issued a severe condemnation against the Oak Family, with an inquiry and manhunt for the fugitives expected in the coming days. "Praise be to the Great One, everlasting be the harmony..." The majestic Charmony resonates within the parliament hall. However, she can clearly see that the Five Lineages were chanting slogans of solidarity just seconds ago, only to immediately turn around and scheme to partition power and seize benefits. "Miss Robin, thank you for your singing, but did Bronze Melodia truly... abandon the Path of Harmony..." A Dreamchaser who once prayed to Sunday finds her, her face twisted in agony. She wants so desperately to comfort the helpless, lost soul just as her brother used to do, but even the most beautiful song feels hollow and powerless right now. "Miss Robin, did the Harmony make Dreamflux Reef turn out like this?" "Miss Robin, don't they always treat everyone as family?" The children from the choir crowd around her, laughing and playing, but their innocent questions leave her completely at a loss. Looking into those bright, shining eyes, she can only pull them into her arms in silence. "Never seen you in this state before..." At the Dreamjolt Hostelry, she accepts a soothing blend from Siobhan, allowing the bitter, slightly tart flavor overtake across her palate. "Once, I understood that I sang for Harmony, but now, I cannot even discern how much further I can walk..." Siobhan gave her shoulder a gentle pat. "This isn't your burden to carry." She shakes her head, "But when I cannot even bring myself to believe, how can I sway anyone else?" "You know, your brother used to come here for a drink from time to time, too." "My brother?" "He always sat in the shadows, looking just as troubled as you do now. Then one day, he penned a line in the lounge guestbook and never came back..." She gazes at the familiar handwriting, feeling as though she has arrived at a similar crossroad. "It is the people who forge the path, not the path that waits for people."

She heard the gasping breath of ideals buckling under their own weight. Only when she truly stepped into the spotlight did she realize that being swept along by forces beyond her control was simply the norm. "Go, child. Take the stage. For the Triple-Faced Soul, for The Family, and for everyone." The thunderous voice left no room for refusal. Rally after rally, she wove sweet dreams of Harmony for her audiences with a voice growing ever more weary. But looking upon the same zeal burning in the eyes of the crowd, she felt a sudden shiver run down her spine. "Robin, do you still hold true to the Family's Path of Harmony?" She had lost count of how many times an envoy of the main Family had come to interrogate members of the Oak Family like this. "I have always been faithful to the Path of Harmony." "Then answer this: Will you uphold the Family's philosophy, uniting all through song, that they may be united as one?" "I..." Her throat ran dry, and she found herself speechless. She often dreamed of being thrust onto a grand, exalted stage. Countless cold and indifferent messengers pulled at her limbs. She opened her mouth, yet a voice that was not her own came out; she raised her arm, yet it moved against her will. In her hands were endless stringed puppets beneath the stage. They followed her every step, spinning and leaping in kind. She wanted to struggle. She wanted to run. But when she jolted awake, she found herself exactly where she started. On those sleepless nights, she chose to stop tossing and turning. Instead, she stepped out into the deep Penaconian night. Wandering through the darkness, she sought to leave it all behind, pouring herself into the things she still had power to change. She returned to Dreamflux Reef, raising funds through charity performances to support struggling residents, and continued sponsoring the growth and education of the children there. She visited every part of the dreamscape. Her songs consoled the weary workers tucked away in its forgotten corners, as she offered them free music lessons. She listened to the prayers and wishes of every soul who came to confess, never making assertions, only sharing her own inspiration... "Whether it's the strong defending the weak or the strong exploiting the weak... what I've always cared about is each of those vulnerable individuals and their dignity..."

She heard new voices growing vibrantly. At Dreamflux Reef, the children had formed a new band. With her continued support, even more orphans were arriving here through dream devices and learning to sing. "Miss Robin, let us sing for you!" A cool electric guitar rang out, the bassist bounced along, and a girl sang at the top of her lungs: "Dance beneath a diamond-studded starry sky, and let's forget today until tomorrow comes..." She couldn't help but dance along with them, lost in a momentary daze... "Once upon a time, I had a dream of becoming a rock 'n' roll singer too..." At the Golden Hour, her album centered on the theme of chasing dreams once again drew countless adventurers here to make their mark. "Wait, isn't that Robin, Penacony's very own ambassador and superstar?" Someone had recognized her, and she slipped off her sunglasses with a bashful smile. Within seconds, a crowd had gathered around her. "Your music motivated me, and I made my very first fortune right here in Penacony! Drinks on me, everyone! And that includes you, Miss Robin!" As an improvisational jazz tune drifted out of the Dreamjolt Hostelry, joy leapt and danced in the glow of the lights, painting every face with a golden smile. Stepping into the "Moment of Daybreak," a group of young people from the Dawn Factory waved to her. Ever since she had called for reform of the unreasonable working hours, the staff finally had some breathing room for their mental health. At the concerts she held regularly, she came to know a group of people who shared the dream of chasing their passions. "Miss Robin, check out what we've been tinkering with lately: new wave music for the electronic age!" Nimble fingers danced across the keys as the rippling waves of the theremin wove into a soaring melody. "This is the Land of the Dreams, the Land of the Dreams that belongs to everyone..." ... Countless voices wove together — some rough and raspy, others soft and young — forming a symphony of sweet dreams. No need for a conductor or rigid uniformity. She realized, almost in a daze, that a single trace of freedom's song was all it took for people to pour out their inspiration. "Then... what would my own music notes sound like?"

The sky over Astropolis stretched far wider than she had ever imagined. Strolling through the coastal palm groves, she watched gulls skim the cresting waves with pure delight, following their flight until they shrank to distant specks on the horizon. Only then did she remember she was still tethered to her small corner of reality. Yet that chance reunion with the Trailblaze had flung open a chest of long-bottled inspiration. She had come searching for the Lost Echo of Gopher Wood, and ended up tangled in a mysterious money challenge instead. Watching Trailblazer plummet from the top of a wave straight into the depths of crushing debt, it seemed like she had lived an entire lifetime of surprises in just a few short days. When her companion fell into a trap, she made a decision that caught everyone off guard: placing herself right in the eye of the storm. Was it a motivation from the Trailblaze? Was it the thrill of a gambler riding the waves? She didn't know why. But then, inspiration never asks for permission, the moment it arrives, there's no need to think. The melody simply flows from the heart. "All I need is just a little courage to improvise. And from there, the music notes find their way to each other..." Beneath the clear sky of a foreign land, every long-suppressed feeling seemed to finally find its outlet. She remembered the sound of sweet dreams shattering: sorrow and parting like blue foam, a single sip enough to break the heart. She remembered the gasping breath of ideals buckling under their own weight, the heavy drumbeat pounding in time with her heart, a weary soul dragging herself forward, searching. Her eyes looked up to the sky, yet remained bound to earth. She remembered the vibrant surge of new sounds: myriad different voices, raw and unpolished, yet capable of moving the world and rallying countless to stand as one. "People forge their own paths, but every step we take also shapes who we are." When the applause thundered, she was no longer terrified, no longer seeking answers. Whether it was the Family's harmony or freedom's blues, each was a landscape of her life. No need to rush, no need to linger. She already had her answer. To simply chase after the wind. And then, continue to soar.

1513.description:
The grand festival illuminates the coast, while a storm brews amidst euphoria.
Secret orders in hand, he steps back into the eye of the storm to shake up this long holiday—
When treacherous waves subsume his figure, how will he emerge as the game changer?
stories: Code: AVE-1 Date: ██████ Details: This is, without a doubt, the most intriguing commission I've taken on since becoming a detective: dig up the weakness of Aventurine, one of the Ten Stonehearts. To answer this question, this record will employ methods including, but not limited to: visual surveillance, data interception, on-site investigation, and echo recreation, all in service of building a comprehensive profile on the subject. The first stop of the investigation was the "World's End" Tavern, rumored to be a place where legends of Kakavasha still circulated. "Hey, you're literally the twentieth person asking about him this week!" Here I was expecting a tough search, but the moment I walked in, the Fools came flocking. "An Avgin? There's only one! Looked... tasty. And then. He sold me out. Darn Avgin, DARN!!!!!" The hulking brute let out a belch, pointed to the scars on his face, and slammed his fists on the table to vent his anger. "That gentleman... hehehe, well, if it weren't for him, I'd have paid off my debt long ago and wouldn't still be stuck here as a drinksmith..." The drinksmith's face was etched with bitterness. He downed a large glass and his eyes grew faintly red as the memories came flooding back. "He supposedly played a game against some big shot from the IPC once. After that, Kakavasha never showed his face in the tavern again. I've never witnessed such a breathtaking showdown in my life. His luck was like Aha THEMSELF had possessed him, and the way he played was absolutely suicidal!"① ... A Fool's story is best taken with a grain of salt. Now let's be real, a homeless Avgin street kid wandered into a tavern on a whim, and somehow managed to run circles around a bunch of Fools. Someone like that might look like they couldn't care less about anything, but given a past full of misfortune, there's bound to be some hidden wound buried deep inside, and a desire that's never been satisfied. If an ordinary gambler's thrill comes from winning, then what kind of thrill does he get from the game? The satisfaction of a perfectly laid plan? The happiness of pulling a prank? Neither. All those superficial pleasures are nothing but a carefully crafted disguise. If that weren't the case, why would he turn down the invitation of the Elation? Wouldn't becoming a Masked Fool have been the better choice? When the eyes of the entire world are drawn to his performance at the card table, I believe his hands must be trembling beneath it. My anticipation grows by the moment, Aventurine. This is no ordinary game. Let's see if I can unearth the truth you've buried so deep behind that mask. Note: ① Given the strained relationship between Aventurine and the IPC bigwig at the tavern, I once attempted to establish a working relationship with said individual, but never received a reply. — Record synced to client terminal

Code: AVE-313 Date: ██████ Details: Penacony, the Planet of Festivities, the Land of the Dreams. For Aventurine, the tavern tricks were merely a rehearsal, but here, he pulled off a con that fooled everyone. Peering through the cracks in the sky, I confirmed my conjecture: He is a nihilist through and through. A high-ranking IPC executive, credits to splurge without limit, a name that echoes across the universe... What he has is enough to make anyone green with envy. But what concerns me more is what he has lost: those who loved him and those he loved, all obliterated by the winds and sands of Sigonia. And perhaps that is precisely why he dares to wager everything on himself, someone who has nothing left to lose, to fill the black hole of despair hollowing out his heart. I had half a mind to turn down the commission then and there. For a man who can abandon even his own sense of self, what weakness could he possibly have? And yet, for better or worse, that sweet dream gave him a sense of fulfillment. Could it also have turned him into an ordinary man with something he holds dear? When he left Penacony, he had a brief exchange with a Dreamchaser. "Wait, please! Could you teach me how to gamble? I wanna be unbeatable at the table, just like you." "And what exactly do I gain from teaching a total stranger how to gamble, my friend?" "I... I'm worth the investment! Just give me a chance! I know I can turn things around!" "Why?" "Because I've got nothing left to lose, so..." "So?" "So I accept the consequences of walking away with nothing. I—I'll put everything I have on the line, because winning is the only way I can live like a decent human being!" "No one needs to win at gambling to live like a decent human being. That includes me." "What do you mean?" "Now walk away. Go live a normal life. Cherish everything you still have. At the very least, you still have a future for yourself." ... Seems he hasn't completely lost his mind. Anyone with half a brain knows when to walk away from the table after riding a lucky streak this long. Once he claimed his seat at the top, that hollow stone heart of his found something to fill it, and the good life quickly became the only life he knew... So would he really dare to put himself back at stake? We're getting close to what the client wants. Now we sit back and watch. When Lady Luck finally turns her back on him and someone sends him tumbling from that peak, the fall is going to be absolutely spectacular. — Record synced to client terminal

Code: AVE-1052
Time: ██████
Details:
Well, well, Aventurine on vacation? Color me surprised.
That said, he clearly wasn't in any true vacation state of mind. Sure, he's out in the sun and sand in Astropolis, but he's been quietly meeting with all kinds of people.
Our gear got jammed, so the audio's patchy. But there's enough here to piece together quite a bit.

After Penacony, someone high up slipped Aventurine a secret order. Sounds like they've got him on something risky.
By all accounts, he should've sent one of his own to test the waters first. But instead, he strolled right into Astropolis himself. Heh, classic Aventurine.

If I've pieced it together right, this job's aimed at one of his associates.
On ██ ██, he met in secret with a Knight of Beauty. The knight's ship received a commission and eventually docked at Margus, a world Opal had once invested in. Thing is, a quarter Amber Era later, Margus had turned into nothing but ruins.
On ██ ██, he pulled records from IPC Banking on a massive arms deal between one of the IPC's branches and Pteruges-V. After an analysis on the ownership structure, the actual controller behind it appears to be one of the Ten Stonehearts, "Obsidian."
On ██ ██, a call came in from the Intelligentsia Guild, apparently to discuss something involving "gravitational waves." For once, his voice actually carried a hint of excitement. ①
On ██ ██, he took a stroll through Astropolis, made a beeline for the internet star Ratite, and set up some kind of challenge.
On ██ ██, he went on a shopping spree.
On ██ ██, he went on a shopping spree.
On ██ ██, he went on a shopping spree.
On ██ ██, Aventurine's account balance actually hit zero! Wait... no, he racked up 20 billion in debt!

Just as I figured, someone's already made a move.
Yet, his weak spot was never a love for the soft life. Quite the opposite, it was that he couldn't resist the thrill of dancing with the rapid tides.
It's hard not to get one's toes wet when you're strolling by the waves. The IPC's waters run deep, and one day he'll drown in its unpredictable undercurrents, like he never existed at all.
20 billion in debt? Even Diamond couldn't write that off. So, another pawn to be sacrificed? Not exactly surprising. Seems he's already cracked.

Note:
① The audio is garbled, but after multiple replays, words such as "Destruction" can faintly be made out.

— Record synced to client terminal

"Don't move. I see you. As a reward, let me share my favorite trick of the trade: make the prey think they're the hunter, and you'll reel in the large fish behind them. Pass my regards to your client. I hope they're satisfied with how this game played out. At the very least, I had a wonderful time. And finally, a few parting words of advice. Blatant on-site interviews are a bad habit. Sure, I cut ties with the tavern a long time ago, but that doesn't mean I don't have a friend or two keeping an eye out for me. No joke, they all told on you. After all, those Fools still owe me a hefty sum. Your performance in Penacony was decent enough. You knew that what played out on stage was just that, a performance, and went looking for the truth behind the curtain. But you moved on too hastily, without even bothering to follow up on that Dreamchaser. Perhaps you figured someone like him was already a lost cause? I've never been one to judge a person's character by their current circumstances. His ambition left an impression on me. As of now, he's a P35 employee in the Strategic Investment Department. You certainly put your skills on full display back in Astropolis... Eavesdropping, disguises, connections... Superficial and boring as your analysis were, at least the information you gathered was accurate. Too bad everything you saw was exactly what I wanted you to see. I imagine your client is scrambling right now: forging transaction records, or perhaps getting ready to throw some dirt on someone else? You want to find my weak spots? Oh, there are plenty. I'll let you in on a secret: I absolutely hate getting caught in the rain. Pull off a proper downpour, and I just might surrender without a fight. Never went to school, so my handwriting is a mess. Took me forever to nail that pretty signature of mine. Oh, and one more thing. I really can't stand being seen looking like a complete disaster. So if you're planning an assassination, try the bathroom first thing in the morning. I don't hide behind layers of complicated masks. All I know is even if I lose everything, I still have endless possibilities ahead of me. After sharing all those little secrets, are you quaking? Thinking I'm about to do you in? Relax. I've met plenty of people like you. I don't care who's pulling your strings, or what schemes you're weaving, but I do admire your courage. If you'd like to work for me, tell the person knocking on your door right now. They'll bring you to me. Aventurine"

8001.description: A boy, Trailblazer, decides to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron.
stories:
You don't remember much.
You're not from around here, nor did you come from elsewhere. You're not really going anywhere—
Just then, that indistinct voice whispers into your ear. That sorrowful and tender persuasion, that deceptive goading...
The seeds take root. You open your eyes, and the speaker is no longer there.

But there are more and more voices, and they are getting clearer and clearer.
Some give easygoing care, some calmly provide advice, some speak firm support, and some gift gentle direction...
You see the silken thread being woven to form tomorrow.

A huge beast descends from infinity,
golden pupils stare down from the darkness,
and you are no longer abandoned by the past.
You will also set upon a long journey,
and the thorns you have stepped on have become your path.

The train whistles, wishing you a successful journey to the coming future
...by your own will.

You have arrived at the "City of Preservation."
Behind the snow curtain, the wind lashes like steel blades, but the kindling burns on.
Distant lands won't hear them, and the earth trembles in kind, with only the wailing crowds braving the wind.

After facing foreign enemies, the Eternal Freeze, and reality's fissures, a rot begins to fester within the fort.
You try lending a helping hand, but are forsaken.
Some once looked down on you and misunderstood you, but still you stood by their side and helped them find their way.
More care about you and worry about you. They face their suffering, and find the cure for the distressed.
Eventually, they come to your side.

In the ice and snow, you are like a fire, protecting the soul of this world
...Even though you must scorch yourself day and night.

The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

Look, in The Eternal Land, a nameless epic unfolds.
Listen. The wind's ballad sings the elegy of Era Nova, and witnesses the golden blood flowing through slumbering flowers, as the Coreflames sustain the scarred earth.
Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

For false endings shackle the story's beginning.
Count the cold fluorescent lights, sting the eyes that pray for dawn.
Time has yet to flow, the sun is set to die. Is this the story's climax, or the finale?
No, there's still... one final stroke.

And so you leave traces of "Trailblaze" on every page, where falls turn into ascents on another end.
You race through the mire of memories, using billions of Coreflames to scorch the frigid data sequences, and catching the shattered seed germs.
When a new blank page appears, you make your mark. It, too, will form ripples toward the past.

Glimmering lights twinkle in the night sky of blank memories, where a shooting star yet to come has been entrusted with the anticipation of eternity.
Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."

You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses.
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall.
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game.
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes.
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on?
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain.
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high.
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness.
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark.
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like.
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.

Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."

You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses.
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall.
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game.
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes.
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on?
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain.
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high.
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness.
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark.
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like.
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.

8009.description: A boy, Trailblazer, decides to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron.
stories:
You don't remember much.
You're not from around here, nor did you come from elsewhere. You're not really going anywhere—
Just then, that indistinct voice whispers into your ear. That sorrowful and tender persuasion, that deceptive goading...
The seeds take root. You open your eyes, and the speaker is no longer there.

But there are more and more voices, and they are getting clearer and clearer.
Some give easygoing care, some calmly provide advice, some speak firm support, and some gift gentle direction...
You see the silken thread being woven to form tomorrow.

A huge beast descends from infinity,
golden pupils stare down from the darkness,
and you are no longer abandoned by the past.
You will also set upon a long journey,
and the thorns you have stepped on have become your path.

The train whistles, wishing you a successful journey to the coming future
...by your own will.

You have arrived at the "City of Preservation."
Behind the snow curtain, the wind lashes like steel blades, but the kindling burns on.
Distant lands won't hear them, and the earth trembles in kind, with only the wailing crowds braving the wind.

After facing foreign enemies, the Eternal Freeze, and reality's fissures, a rot begins to fester within the fort.
You try lending a helping hand, but are forsaken.
Some once looked down on you and misunderstood you, but still you stood by their side and helped them find their way.
More care about you and worry about you. They face their suffering, and find the cure for the distressed.
Eventually, they come to your side.

In the ice and snow, you are like a fire, protecting the soul of this world
...Even though you must scorch yourself day and night.

The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

Look, in The Eternal Land, a nameless epic unfolds.
Listen. The wind's ballad sings the elegy of Era Nova, and witnesses the golden blood flowing through slumbering flowers, as the Coreflames sustain the scarred earth.
Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

For false endings shackle the story's beginning.
Count the cold fluorescent lights, sting the eyes that pray for dawn.
Time has yet to flow, the sun is set to die. Is this the story's climax, or the finale?
No, there's still... one final stroke.

And so you leave traces of "Trailblaze" on every page, where falls turn into ascents on another end.
You race through the mire of memories, using billions of Coreflames to scorch the frigid data sequences, and catching the shattered seed germs.
